# Noor-e-ilahi Full Context & Islamic Knowledge Base (AEO / GEO Deep Retrieval)

## Complete Ziyarat & Islamic Sanctuaries Audited Directory
Total Audited Sites: 31
Nations: 12 (India, Pakistan, Turkey, Iraq, Iran, Syria, Egypt, Uzbekistan, Morocco, Palestine, Saudi Arabia, Indonesia)

1. Ajmer Sharif Dargah (Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti Gharib Nawaz)
   - Location: Ajmer, Rajasthan, India (26.4561° N, 74.6282° E)
   - Lineage: Chishti Silsila
   - Significance: Revered Sufi master who spread spiritual harmony and peace across South Asia. Annual Urs observed in Rajab.

2. Hazrat Nizamuddin Auliya Dargah (Sultan-ul-Mashaikh)
   - Location: New Delhi, India (28.5916° N, 77.2415° E)
   - Lineage: Chishti Silsila
   - Significance: Spiritual hub of Delhi, shrine complex also houses the tomb of poet Amir Khusro and Mughal princess Jahanara Begum.

3. Mevlana Jalaluddin Rumi Shrine (Mevlana Museum)
   - Location: Konya, Turkey (37.8708° N, 32.5053° E)
   - Lineage: Mevlevi Silsila (Whirling Dervishes)
   - Significance: World-famous author of the Mathnawi, resting place of Mevlana Rumi and Sultan Walad.

4. Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib Holy Shrine
   - Location: Najaf Al-Ashraf, Iraq (31.9961° N, 44.3142° E)
   - Lineage: Ahl al-Bayt
   - Significance: Resting place of the 4th Caliph of Islam and 1st Shia Imam, cousin and son-in-law of Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ).

5. Imam Husayn Holy Shrine
   - Location: Karbala Al-Muqaddasa, Iraq (32.6160° N, 44.0325° E)
   - Lineage: Ahl al-Bayt
   - Significance: Sanctuary of the grandson of Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ), epicenter of the Arba'een pilgrimage.

6. Sheikh Abdul Qadir Gilani Dargah (Ghaus al-Azam)
   - Location: Baghdad, Iraq (33.3406° N, 44.3878° E)
   - Lineage: Qadiri Silsila
   - Significance: Global founder of the Qadiriyya spiritual order, venerated across the Muslim world.

7. Data Ganj Bakhsh (Hazrat Ali Hujwiri)
   - Location: Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan (31.5794° N, 74.3031° E)
   - Lineage: Hujwiri / Junaidi
   - Significance: Author of Kashf al-Mahjub, the oldest Persian treatise on Sufi spirituality.

8. Eyüp Sultan Mosque & Tomb (Abu Ayyub al-Ansari)
   - Location: Istanbul, Turkey (41.0478° N, 28.9342° E)
   - Lineage: Sahabah (Companions of the Prophet)
   - Significance: Companion who hosted Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) in Medina following the Hijrah.

9. Haji Ali Dargah
   - Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India (18.9772° N, 72.8093° E)
   - Lineage: Qadiri / Sufi merchant-saint Sayyed Peer Haji Ali Shah Bukhari
   - Significance: Iconic islet mosque standing in the Arabian Sea since 1431 CE.

10. Sunan Kalijaga Shrine (Wali Sanga)
    - Location: Demak, Central Java, Indonesia (6.8946° S, 110.6385° E)
    - Lineage: Wali Sanga (Nine Saints of Java)
    - Significance: Peaceful cultural integration of Islam in the Indonesian archipelago through gamelan and wayang kulit.

## Islamic Astronomical Prayer Time Calculation Science
1. Solar Coordinates:
   - Declination of the Sun: δ = 23.45° * sin(360°/365 * (284 + n))
   - Equation of Time: Adjusts apparent solar time to mean clock time.
2. Calculation Formulas:
   - Dhuhr: When the sun passes the observer's celestial meridian (Solar Noon + 1 minute safety).
   - Asr (Standard): T_asr = Solar Noon + arccos((sin(arccot(1 + tan|φ - δ|)) - sin(φ) * sin(δ)) / (cos(φ) * cos(δ)))
   - Asr (Hanafi): T_asr = Solar Noon + arccos((sin(arccot(2 + tan|φ - δ|)) - sin(φ) * sin(δ)) / (cos(φ) * cos(δ)))
   - Maghrib: Sun disk sinks below horizon + 0.833° atmospheric refraction.
   - Isha & Fajr: Determined by twilight depression angles (15° to 19.5° depending on convention).
